capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Kia US 2026 EV6 page: 84.0 kWh on Light Long Range, Wind, GT-Line.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: EV Database (MY25-27): 80.0 kWh usable of 84.0 nominal (EV Database GT page agrees).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: EV Database: 800 V architecture (697 V nominal).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Kia UK page names the EV6: navigation trigger (charger as destination) plus manual start from infotainment/Kia Connect app. UK page, not NA; the 2024 EV6 manual (src-kia-manual-ev6-2024-battery-conditioning) shows the same setting; nothing shows a change at the 2025 refresh.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Kia chart relayed by Automoblog is for the 2025 EV6 (Light 180 kW, other 84 kWh trims 240 kW); the 2026/2027 car has the same pack and charger. Automoblog Kia-sourced chart: 240 kW max DC input for the 84 kWh trims (EV Database 263 kW and ArenaEV 258 kW are EU claims).

ac_max_kw.notes: Kia US 2026 EV6 page: 10.9 kW onboard charger.

published_10_80_min.notes: Kia US 2026 EV6: about 20 min 10-80 % at 350 kW (GT AWD test figure).
